scripts.docker:build: docker build --cache-from monica-next -t monica-next -f scripts/docker/Dockerfile . && docker image prune -f
scripts.api:generate: cargo run -q --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -- openapi > resources/js/api/openapi.json && openapi-typescript resources/js/api/openapi.json -o resources/js/api/schema.d.ts && node scripts/generate-api-client.mjs resources/js/api/openapi.json && prettier --write resources/js/api/client.js resources/js/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.api:draft: python3 docs/rewrite/tools/spec.py --json resources/js/api/openapi.json && openapi-typescript resources/js/api/openapi.json -o resources/js/api/schema.d.ts && node scripts/generate-api-client.mjs resources/js/api/openapi.json && prettier --write resources/js/api/client.js resources/js/api/schema.d.ts
